summary: Alterity Therapeutics Limited, an Australian development-stage biopharmaceutical company, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC for September 2026. The filing consists solely of an exhibit (99.1) containing an application for quotation of securities (ATH) on the Australian Securities Exchange, accompanied by a graphic image. No financial terms, transaction details, or corporate events are disclosed in the text. The submission is a routine regulatory notification regarding securities quotation, with no special-situation characteristics such as mergers, capital returns, or strategic transactions. The registrant acts purely as a filer reporting standard corporate administrative matters.
